name: Crimson Crate Delivery
summary: A customer named Howin Kindfeather has ordered the crimson whelps. You are asked to carry his crate from Menethil Harbor to a spot off the eastern road.

sections.title: A Customer Awaits
sections.body: The order is packed for Howin Kindfeather, whose gryphon carried a letter into Menethil Harbor. You are to take the Crimson Crate to him off the road east of town, a little beyond Whelgar's Excavation Site. Howin is waiting for the delivery.

faq.answer: Howin Kindfeather placed the order for the crimson whelps.
Howin is off the road east of Menethil Harbor, a little beyond Whelgar's Excavation Site.
The crate holds the whelps Howin ordered, packed up for delivery.

faq.q: How did Howin place the order?
faq.answer: Howin sent his gryphon into Menethil Harbor with a letter for the order.

attribution: In-game quest text: Crimson Crate Delivery
